title: Garlic Butter Pasta
author: Sousbot fixture
ingredients:
200 g spaghetti
4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
3 tbsp unsalted butter
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and black pepper
Parsley, chopped
directions: Cook pasta in well-salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Gently cook garlic in butter and oil until fragrant, not brown.
Toss pasta with garlic butter, adding pasta water to loosen.
